questions.prompt: What must you add before a service can inject HttpClient?
questions.explanation: Register HttpClient once, usually in app.config.ts. Without it you get "No provider for HttpClient".

questions.prompt: When does this.http.get("/api/products") send the request?

options.text: When something subscribes to the returned observable

questions.explanation: HTTP observables are cold: each subscription (subscribe, async pipe, toSignal) sends its own request.

questions.prompt: What does an HttpErrorResponse with status 0 usually mean?

options.text: The request succeeded with an empty body
No response arrived: offline, server unreachable, or blocked by CORS
The JSON could not be parsed

questions.explanation: Status 0 means the browser never got an HTTP response. Check the connection and the console for CORS errors.

questions.prompt: What is the safest way to send ?q=rope&page=2 with a GET request?
questions.explanation: The params option builds and encodes the query string for you.

questions.prompt: Which signal-based API loads data over HTTP and re-fetches automatically when signals in its URL function change (____(() => url))?
questions.explanation: httpResource() exposes value(), isLoading(), error(), and reload(). It is stable since Angular 22.

questions.prompt: Your app on localhost:4200 cannot read responses from an API on localhost:3000 because of CORS. What is the usual fix during development?

options.text: Use the dev-server proxy (proxy.conf.json) so the app calls /api on its own origin

questions.explanation: CORS is enforced by the browser and allowed by the server. Locally, ng serve can forward /api calls; in production, configure the server.
